From 789d54a4178634850e441f60c0326124138e7269 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Quinn Tran <qutran@marvell.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jun 2022 21:46:25 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] scsi: qla2xxx: edif: Fix n2n discovery issue with secure
 target

User failed to see disk via n2n topology. Driver used up all login retries
before authentication application started. When authentication application
started, driver did not have enough login retries to connect securely. On
app_start, driver will reset the login retry attempt count.

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220607044627.19563-10-njavali@marvell.com
Fixes: 4de067e5df12 ("scsi: qla2xxx: edif: Add N2N support for EDIF")
Signed-off-by: Quinn Tran <qutran@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Nilesh Javali <njavali@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c
index 3ece46ae9d6b..d31dd942bfb0 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c
@@ -515,6 +515,9 @@ qla_edif_app_start(scsi_qla_host_t *vha, struct bsg_job *bsg_job)
 	}
 
 	if (N2N_TOPO(vha->hw)) {
+		list_for_each_entry_safe(fcport, tf, &vha->vp_fcports, list)
+			fcport->n2n_link_reset_cnt = 0;
+
 		if (vha->hw->flags.n2n_fw_acc_sec)
 			set_bit(N2N_LINK_RESET, &vha->dpc_flags);
 		else
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c`**
- Added a loop that resets the `n2n_link_reset_cnt` for each `fcport` in the `vp_fcports` list of the `vha` (virtual host adapter) structure. This is done at the beginning of the `qla_edif_app_start` function.
  
### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug related to the n2n (node-to-node) discovery issue with secure targets. The previous implementation did not reset the login retry attempt count when the authentication application started, leading to failed disk visibility. By resetting the `n2n_link_reset_cnt`, the driver ensures that it has sufficient login retries available for secure connections, thus improving the functionality of the n2n topology. This change is a direct fix to the issue introduced in a prior commit (identified by the Fixes tag).

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
fcport->login_retry = vha->hw->login_retry_count;
```
```c
if (N2N_TOPO(vha->hw)) {
```
```c

```
Reason:
The driver sets the `login_retry` count to the maximum allowed value before the authentication application starts. If the driver exhausts all login retries before the application is initiated, it cannot establish a secure connection, leading to the failure in disk visibility via the n2n topology. The check for `N2N_TOPO` indicates that the driver is in a specific topology mode, but without sufficient retries, it cannot proceed. The condition checking `scan_state` prevents further actions if the port is not found, which can also contribute to the issue.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
list_for_each_entry_safe(fcport, tf, &vha->vp_fcports, list)
    fcport->n2n_link_reset_cnt = 0;
```
```c
if (vha->hw->flags.n2n_fw_acc_sec)
    set_bit(N2N_LINK_RESET, &vha->dpc_flags);
```
Reason:
The patch resets the `n2n_link_reset_cnt` for each `fcport`, ensuring that the login retry count is effectively refreshed when the authentication application starts. This allows the driver to have available login retries to establish a secure connection. Additionally, setting the `N2N_LINK_RESET` flag indicates that the driver should attempt to re-establish the connection, thus addressing the root cause of the issue.
